tools.description: Confirm one GTIN as a beverage alcohol product the trade will move: well-formed, seen (pages and dates), CUVEE category, strength, container, deposit, excise class, age-gated, markets and banners seen, signed. Unknown means no observation, never a guess.

gtin.description: The GTIN as printed: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits (spaces allowed)

market.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 market (uk, de, fr …) to say whether the product was seen there

pay.description: Optional. true asks for the paid confirm: an x402 settlement on Base (HTTP 402 with the offer until PAYMENT-SIGNATURE is sent) and a signed receipt with the answer. Without it the confirm is open access.

tools.name: confirm_gtin
tools.title: Confirm a beverage alcohol GTIN
